text: The purpose of this report is to present the 2020 first quarter financial results to the Board.

The TO Live - Audit Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the 2020 first quarter financial operating results, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 and 2 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 and 2 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live, remain confidential in their entirety because if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons, or organization.
